ov: About 3,000 species of social insects that eat decaying plant matter, mostly wood, leaf litter and humus. Though called “white ants”, they are highly specialised cockroaches. A colony is founded by a king and queen that mate for life.

why.et: Eaten in some cultures; winged alates are high in fat and protein, and queens are regarded as a delicacy.

len: Mostly 4–15 mm; Macrotermes queens up to 15 cm
rg: Every continent except Antarctica; about 1,000 species live in Africa.
df: Decaying plant material: wood, leaf litter and soil humus.
fx: About 1.1 million active termite mounds stand in the northern Kruger National Park alone.
Termites and ants are about 1% of insect species but more than half of all insect biomass.
notes: RESOLVED (owner approved all suggestions, 2026-09-29; h left unchanged for bumblebee, hornet and firefly): Group entry. The fact is confirmed: some mounds reach 8 to 9 metres, some face north–south to regulate temperature, and a queen can live 30 to 50 years.
